scripts.docs: npm run build && NO_MKDOCS_2_WARNING=1 mkdocs build --strict
scripts.docs:serve: npm run build && NO_MKDOCS_2_WARNING=1 mkdocs serve -a 127.0.0.1:8095
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:coverage: vitest run --coverage && COVERAGE=1 npm run build && COVERAGE=1 playwright test && npm run build
